title: Quanto custa a maçã?
goal: Pergunte preço com How much is…? e How much are…?
reading: Lia looks at the apples in a small market.
Lia olha as maçãs numa feira pequena.
She reads the sign near the box.
Ela lê a placa perto da caixa.
“How much are the apples?” she asks.
“Two dollars a kilogram,” the man says.
“Dois dólares o quilo”, diz o homem.
dialogue: They are two dollars a kilogram.
Is there a price for one apple?
Yes, one apple is fifty cents.
Sim, uma maçã custa cinquenta centavos.
And how much is this candy?
Only one cent, the same as a penny.
Só um centavo, o mesmo que uma moedinha.
pron: O acento fica na primeira sílaba: KÍ-lo-gram.
